cards.title: BUG · offer discount storage: NULL (new_offer) vs 0.0 (edit_offer) for zero percentages + asymmetric recalc write-back
cards.description: Pinned by tests/characterization/test_offer_recalc.py::test_null_discounts_behave_as_zero_and_are_partially_persisted. new_offer (offer/app.py:590-592) stores NULL for zero discount/vat inputs, edit_offer (offer/app.py:847-849) stores 0.0 for the same input; recalc_totals then coerces NULL/0 via 'or 0.0' and writes special/third back as floats while leaving discount_percent/vat_percent NULL (offer/app.py:788-800). Net effect is benign today (both read as no-discount) but the schema carries two encodings of the same fact and the asymmetric write-back makes DB state depend on which form last touched the row. Related: L11 (floats for money), L4 (schema created by two init paths with slightly different definitions).
cards.rationale: Phase 2's single-schema/service-layer work needs the canonical encoding decided (NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0 everywhere or explicit NULL semantics) before data migration; the pinned test will be re-baselined with that decision.
cards.rejected: One-time data migration (UPDATE offers SET ... WHERE IS NULL in migrate_offer_tables): legacy rows are already read as zero everywhere ("or 0.0"), recalc now normalizes them lazily on every recalculation -- a blanket migration would be a schema change beyond the bug scope. Decimal-based money storage stays Phase 3 (L11).
cards.summary: recalc_totals now writes back all four percentage columns coerced to 0.0 (single encoding of no-discount). Probe showed new_offer/edit_offer already store 0.0; the live asymmetry was the recalc write-back. New route-level regression file + deliberate re-baseline of the partial-persistence pin. Suite 131 passed.

cards.title: P2 stage 1 — single app + blueprints, no DispatcherMiddleware
cards.summary: Six Flask instances collapsed into one app (qp_crm/main.py) registering api_v1(/api/v1), settings, sale, pricing, offer, rent, admin blueprints with unchanged prefixes; DispatcherMiddleware deleted; one qp_session cookie + QP_SECRET_KEY; per-module auth flags kept (pricing/offer/rent/admin_authenticated).
cards.rationale: First P2 stage: multiple app instances meant six secret configs, no shared session, and template-filter registration races. One app is the precondition for every later stage.
cards.rejected: Keeping DispatcherMiddleware with shared secret config: still six template namespaces and six wsgi entry points; consolidation without the middleware deletion would have preserved the drift it exists to fix.

cards.title: P2 stage 2 — dedupe helpers into shared/web.py
cards.summary: Duplicated helpers consolidated into qp_crm/shared/web.py: get_theme/get_date_format/format_date_filter/fix_markdown_lists/render_markdown/make_auth_hook(session_flag, login_endpoint, exempt_endpoints)/register_product_image/save_product_image(+download_image_from_url with caller-supplied EN/SR errors)/fetch_mandatory_fields/fetch_rent_defaults/sort_rent_templates/DEFAULT_RENT_EMAIL*. format_date/md registered once app-wide in main.py.
cards.rationale: Six copies of the same helpers had drifted (error strings, sort orders); one shared module is the base for the routes split and the service layer.
cards.rejected: A utils Mixin / flask Blueprint-level helpers: mixins hide dependencies and make per-module auth flags awkward; plain functions with explicit imports keep call sites greppable.

cards.title: P2 stage 3 — single schema source in shared/schema.py
cards.summary: Single DDL source qp_crm/shared/schema.py: create_pricing/offer/admin/rent_tables (canonical supersets incl. client_pib/client_mb/discount_percent in CREATE; REAL price_rounding_rules columns) + add_column_if_missing + migrate_pricing (guarded UNIQUE idx_products_name_unique COLLATE NOCASE + legacy-UNIQUE prices rebuild) + migrate_offer/rent_tables. All five init/migrate entry points route through it.
cards.rationale: Two init paths had slightly different table definitions (audit L4) — the canonical-superset DDL removes drift between fresh and migrated DBs.
cards.rejected: Raw .sql schema files: string templates lose the guarded idempotent-migration helpers (add_column_if_missing) and dialect nuances (COLLATE NOCASE, partial indexes) that python can express precisely.

cards.title: P2 stage 4 — service layer + sandboxed Jinja (audit C4 closed)
cards.summary: Pure calculation/business logic extracted to qp_crm/services/: pricing_service.apply_rounding, offer_service.recalc_totals, rent_service (pmt/_add_months/calculate_rent/generate_schedule/_build_doc_context/format_document_html), pdf_service.render_db_template_parts with jinja2.sandbox.SandboxedEnvironment (autoescape=True, filters copied from app jinja_env, pinned globals) — closing audit C4 (DB-template SSTI). Rent document rendering stays literal string substitution (no Jinja surface).
cards.rationale: Money logic was embedded in 1.2–1.8k-line route files, untestable without HTTP; DB-stored templates rendered with the full app Jinja env = arbitrary code execution via admin UI (C4).
cards.rejected: Jinja with disabled autoescape + strip filters for speed: reopens C4; sandbox autoescape measured no significant PDF-render slowdown in the golden tests.

cards.title: P2 stage 5 — split route files into per-domain modules
cards.description: Four parallel subagents split pricing (19 routes → core/products/catalog/prices), offer (14 → core/offers/pdf), rent (20 → core/contracts/documents/catalogs), admin (29 → core/settings/presets/pdf_templates/backup/rounding/rent_templates). Route bodies move verbatim; routes import bp + helpers from ../app; app.py registers via `from . import routes` at the bottom. Zero behavior change; suite green per module commit.
cards.rationale: 1.2–1.8k-line route files were unmaintainable and blocked review; per-domain modules map to the feature areas and set up the qp_crm/ package move.
cards.summary: pricing/routes/{core,products,catalog,prices}, offer/routes/{core,offers,pdf}, rent/routes/{core,contracts,documents,catalogs,pdf}, admin/routes/{core,settings,presets,backup,pdf_templates,rounding,rent_templates} (api_key routes in settings.py). Pattern: route files import from ..app (bp + helpers); app.py bottoms out with 'from . import routes'. Standalone dev: python -m qp_crm.<module>.app.
cards.rejected: Splitting by HTTP verb or by auth level: neither matches how changes actually cluster (a feature touches form+list+pdf together); a follow-up bug in this stage showed the import-check risk — rent/routes/__init__.py must list every route module or its routes silently vanish (fixed by the bad-date regression tests).

cards.title: P2 stage 5 (admin) — split admin/app.py into admin/routes/* domain modules
cards.summary: Created admin/routes/ package (__init__.py + core, settings, presets, pdf_templates, backup, rounding, rent_templates; 1109 lines total) holding all 29 @bp.route functions byte-verbatim; admin/app.py cut from 1296 to 186 lines (keeps bp, before_request hook, 4 init fns, generate_full_backup_zip, ends with `from . import routes`). Verified: AST-parse, 29-decorator tally (0 left in app.py), route multiset identical to HEAD, per-module name coverage (no undefined/unused), verbatim-tail diff vs git HEAD, import smoke test registering the blueprint (29 endpoints, identical URL rules, auth hook present). api_key_generate/api_key_revoke placed in settings.py (missing from the task's per-module list but required by the 29-route invariant). Full pytest/docker run not done here (venv lacks `markdown`; runtime verification belongs to the docker env).
cards.rationale: Stage 5 requires per-domain route modules with zero behavior change; admin was the module assigned to this task in an already-green codebase, so the split had to be byte-verbatim to keep the Phase-1 test safety net valid.
cards.rejected: Moving generate_full_backup_zip() into routes/backup.py — rejected to keep non-route helpers in app.py per plan and to avoid breaking `from admin.app import` consumers (main.py, wsgi.py, tests). Pruning now-unused imports from app.py — rejected, the plan requires everything else left exactly as is.

cards.title: P2 stage 6b — move app code into qp_crm/ package, delete sys.path hacks, rewrite imports
cards.description: git mv (history preserved) of main.py, wsgi.py, shared/, services/, pricing/, offer/, rent/, admin/, sale/, settings/ into qp_crm/ + new qp_crm/__init__.py. Imports rewritten to qp_crm.* everywhere (app code + tests, module-level AND lazy function-level). Repo root keeps templates/, static/, app_data/, app_assets/, tests/, Docker files — docker-compose bind mounts and URLs unchanged.
cards.summary: Moved all app code under qp_crm/ via git mv (93 paths: 69 byte-identical, 24 with import edits); rewrote 124 old-form imports (71 from shared.*, 4 from services.*, 35 cross-module, 6 import shared.*, 7 main, 1 bare from services import); deleted 8 sys.path hack blocks; re-anchored BASE_DIR (3 dirnames), main.py template_folder (BASE_DIR/templates), admin System-Default PDF seeding (PACKAGE_DIR + STATIC_DIR), rent legacy DOCX_DIR (BASE_DIR); Dockerfile CMD -> qp_crm.wsgi:application; run_apps.sh/restart_app.sh -> python -m qp_crm.main. Docker suite: 121 passed.
cards.rationale: Phase 2 stage 6b: proper package layout kills the last sys.path hacks and makes imports unambiguous before Phase 3. BASE_DIR must keep resolving to the repo root because docker-compose bind-mounts ./app_data, ./app_assets, ./static/img at fixed container paths.
cards.rejected: Adding __init__.py to pricing/offer/admin/settings (they were namespace dirs pre-move and keep working as nested namespace subpackages inside the regular qp_crm package — no need). Moving templates/, static/, app_data/ into the package (rejected: breaks compose bind mounts and shared/config BASE_DIR anchoring). sys.modules aliasing old top-level names for backward compat (rejected: dead weight, zero external consumers).

cards.title: Per-user app access (Admin -> Users): which apps each user may open
cards.description: User request after the phase-3 handover: drop the blanket staff-sees-everything model; the admin controls per user which business apps (pricing/offer/rent) they can open, from the admin panel.
cards.rationale: Owner asked for admin-panel control of which apps each user may open, replacing the blanket staff-sees-everything phase-3 model, without reintroducing per-app passwords.
cards.rejected: Separate per-app passwords (the pre-phase-3 problem, explicitly not wanted back); a JSON/CSV modules column (junction table is FK-enforced and extends to Phase-4 modules by appending to MODULE_CHOICES); caching grants in the session (per-request re-read keeps revocation instant); role-per-module combos like 'offer-only role' (roles stay admin/staff binary, grants carry the per-user nuance).
cards.summary: Shipped and deployed (commit 94ee464, image rebuilt, container recreated, grants live): user_modules table (UNIQUE(user_id,module)), users.modules_set marker, shared/web.py require_module(module) gate on pricing/offer/rent blueprints (re-reads grants per request; admin role bypasses), Admin -> Users UI with pricing/offer/rent checkboxes per staff row (own-password confirmed POST /admin/users/<id>/modules) and pre-checked boxes on the create form; one-time boot migration seed_default_user_modules grants existing staff all three apps (marker prevents re-granting deliberately emptied sets); factory reset re-seeds users+grants via the init_users_table contract; role gate is now binary admin/not-admin. 7 new tests in tests/auth/test_module_access.py, suite 225 passed.

cards.title: Landing page: login required + access-filtered app menu
cards.description: User follow-up: anonymous visitors must see only the login page (never the app menu), and the menu should reflect per-user app access.
cards.summary: Commit caba035, deployed and verified: / redirects anonymous to /login; logged-in menu built from get_user_modules (staff: granted apps + public sale/settings cards, admin: all + Admin Panel). Smoke tests: anonymous-redirect + menu-filtering tests, suite 226 passed.
cards.rationale: The static landing page exposed the full module menu (including Admin Panel) to anyone; inconsistent with unified auth and the new per-user app access.
cards.rejected: Caching the menu in the session (grants must reflect per-request DB state like the gates).

cards.title: Users page: one Save per user + sale joins per-user app access
cards.description: User follow-up with screenshot: the Users page had four password fields + four buttons per row (deactivate/role/reset/access) — replace with ONE password + ONE Save per user; also make the sale app per-user controllable.
cards.summary: Commit 0821e0... deployed and verified live: /admin/users/<id>/save combines apps+active+role+optional new password behind one own-password confirm; row UI uses one <form> with HTML5 form= attributes so all cells submit together. Sale gated with require_module('sale'), legacy /sale/login + /sale/logout redirects added, landing card filtered; versioned seed (MODULE_INTRODUCED, users.modules_set = seed version) granted sale to existing staff exactly once. Fixed get_user_by_id to accept include_inactive so deactivated users can be reactivated through the save route. Suite 230 passed.
cards.rationale: Cluttered UI made row actions error-prone (four confirm-password fields per user), and sale was still public despite the per-user access model.
cards.rejected: Separate save buttons per option (that was the complaint); one giant form spanning <td>s via invalid HTML (used the form= attribute instead); re-granting all modules on version bump (would resurrect deliberately revoked grants — MODULE_INTRODUCED grants only modules introduced after the row's last seed version).

cards.title: kad se ode na http://192.168.1.34:5000/admin/ u headeru imam sve opcije ali ako odem u /admin/pdf_templates ili bilo koju drugu pod stranicu header je drugaciji fale opcije poput api key, users nisu u headeru treba da bude sve isto u celoj admin aplikaciji
cards.rationale: Why: each admin template carries its own copy-pasted nav that drifted over time (Users/API Keys/Rent Šabloni missing on some subpages), so the admin app looks broken depending on which page you are on. Root fix is one shared nav include used by every admin template so the header cannot drift again.
cards.summary: 做了什么：created qp_crm/admin/templates/admin/_nav.html (one shared header: Dashboard, PDF Templates, Rounding Rules, Users, API Keys, Rent Šabloni + Home link, no logout) and replaced the drifted copy-pasted navs in all 7 admin templates with `{% set active = ... %}{% include 'admin/_nav.html' %}` (pdf_template_edit keeps its 'Edit: <name>' breadcrumb via nav_extra). Smoke tests assert the full identical header on every admin subpage incl. the editor.
cards.rejected: 放弃了什么：patching the missing Users/API Keys/Rent Šabloni links into each template's existing nav — that is the exact copy-paste drift that caused the bug and would drift again; a Jinja macro with args was also skipped in favor of the include+set idiom the codebase already uses.

cards.title: http://192.168.1.34:5000/admin/rent/templates ne radi samo vodi u krug na http://192.168.1.34:5000/login?next=/admin/
cards.rationale: Why: /admin/rent/templates bounces even a logged-in admin into an endless /login?next=/admin/ circle because the route still checks the pre-Phase-3 admin_authenticated session flag that unified login never sets. The real gate is the blueprint-level require_role("admin") hook, so the stale per-route checks must be removed to restore access.
cards.summary: 做了什么：removed the stale per-route session['admin_authenticated'] checks (pre-Phase-3 flag unified login never sets) from admin/routes/rent_templates.py and admin/routes/backup.py — the blueprint-level require_role("admin") hook is the only gate now, so /admin/rent/templates, /admin/backup_db and /admin/backup_full render for a logged-in admin instead of looping to /login?next=/admin/. Covered by 3 new smoke assertions (tests/smoke/test_smoke_modules.py, 45 passed).
cards.rejected: 放弃了什么：re-seeding the admin_authenticated flag in the routes instead of deleting the checks — it would have kept two auth gates in sync for a flag that Phase 3's unified login made permanently false; require_role is the single source of truth now.

cards.title: Remove the logout button from the header and move it to the setings app
cards.rationale: Why: the red Logout button sits in the header of every page (accidental clicks, wasted header space) and logout is now a single unified /logout anyway. Moving it into the /settings app keeps one quiet logout spot for the whole stack, matching the pricing/offer settings pages that already carry a logout button.
cards.summary: 做了什么：removed the Logout/Odjava buttons from every page header (admin shared nav, pricing/base.html, offer/base.html, rent/base.html) and added one Logout card to the /settings app routing through the unified /logout (auth.logout), styled like the logout cards the pricing/offer in-app settings pages already had. Smoke tests assert no danger button in any app header and /logout present on /settings.
cards.rejected: 放弃了什么：hiding the settings Logout for anonymous visitors — /settings is public and a logout click when logged out just redirects to /login, so state-dependent styling buys nothing; also kept the logout cards on pricing/offer's own settings pages since they are in-page controls, not header buttons.

cards.title: The Landing page button in the header shuld be named home
cards.rationale: Why: the link back to the app menu is labeled "Landing Page" (developer jargon that confused users). Renaming it to "Home" names the thing by what it does; the Serbian translation ('Početna strana') is added for the new key so language switching keeps working.
cards.summary: 做了什么：every header now links the app menu as Home — admin shared nav, pricing/offer/sale base templates (`_('Home')`), settings page; sr translation 'Home' → 'Početna strana' added in shared/utils.py and the dead 'Landing Page' key dropped. Rent keeps its Serbian 'Početna' (same meaning/link). Smoke tests assert '>Home' and the absence of 'Landing Page'.
cards.rejected: 放弃了什么：renaming rent's 'Početna' to English 'Home' — rent is the Serbian-language UI and Početna already means Home; forcing English there would have been inconsistent with the rest of that header.

cards.title: PRE-EXISTING suite failures (not from header/logout work): 2 auth tests vs uncommitted change-password-removal WIP + 3 golden-PDF host-font diffs
cards.description: Detail: (1) tests/auth/test_first_login_flow.py::test_seeded_staff_logs_straight_in_no_forced_change — POSTs /change-password expecting 404, but after unified login the session CSRF token is wiped and nothing re-mints it before the POST, so check_csrf answers 400 (the test's own comment even documents the 400 path). (2) tests/auth/test_user_management.py::test_create_staff_user_forces_first_login_change — asserts must_change_password == 1, the exact behavior the uncommitted WIP (auth/app.py, shared/web.py, admin/routes/users.py, deleted auth/templates/auth/account_password.html — all still uncommitted in the working tree) removed ("password changes live exclusively in Admin -> Users"); test is stale WIP. (3-5) tests/golden/* — baselines are byte-exact against the docker image's pinned fonts-dejavu-core; host WeasyPrint renders differ from byte 54. Fix path: finish/commit the auth WIP and update or delete the two tests; run golden tests only inside docker (docker compose run --rm app pytest), never re-baseline on host.
cards.rationale: Why: while verifying the header/logout tasks the full suite showed 5 failures that reproduce WITHOUT this session's changes — they must be recorded so the next session doesn't attribute them to new work or blindly re-baseline. Discovered 2026-09-05, suite: 240 passed / 5 failed on host.
cards.rejected: 放弃了什么：re-baselining the golden PDFs on the host to make them pass — the baselines are byte-pinned to the docker image's fonts-dejavu-core, so host re-baselines would corrupt the docker-green state; instead the golden tests now SKIP outside the pinned image (QP_UPDATE_GOLDEN is inert there). Also chose not to keep the dead change_own_password service "just in case" — Admin -> Users is the single password-change path now.
cards.summary: 做了什么：finished the uncommitted change-password-removal WIP and made the whole suite green on host (242 passed, 3 skipped): removed the dead change_own_password() service from shared/auth.py, fixed the stale create_users_table docstring in shared/schema.py; rewrote the two stale auth tests — test_seeded_staff_logs_straight_in_no_forced_change now mints a CSRF token explicitly and pins GET /change-password 404 + tokenless POST 400 (CSRF shield) + tokened POST 404 (route gone), test_create_staff_user_forces_first_login_change became test_created_staff_logs_straight_in_no_forced_change pinning must_change_password == 0; tests/golden/test_golden_pdf.py skips outside the pinned docker image (/.dockerenv or cwd /app) with tests/README.md documenting it. Committed as 1e7cfce.

cards.title: Rebuild + restart Docker kontejnera da UI popravke (admin header, rent/templates loop, logout u Settings, Home) postanu vidljive na :5000
cards.description: Popravke (unified admin header, rent/templates loop fix, logout u Settings, Home rename) su u kodu (commitovi ea635a3, 1e7cfce, c790b07) ali server na 192.168.1.34:5000 još drži staru sliku — gunicorn startovan 13:16 pre popravki. Slika nije bind-mount (samo app_data/app_assets/static/img su montirani), pa je potreban rebuild: pokrenuti ./deploy.sh (radi docker compose build + up -d + healthcheck wait). DSH sesija nema docker pristup (nije u docker grupi, sudo blokiran no-new-privileges), pa korisnik pokreće ručno ili se radi na resume kada pristup bude omogućen.
cards.rationale: The container runs baked image layers (only app_data/app_assets/static/img are bind-mounted), so code commits alone could never reach :5000 — a rebuild+recreate is the only way the user sees the fixes in the browser.
cards.summary: 做了什么：SKIP_PULL=1 ./deploy.sh via sudo (docker access opened by the user's policy change): image rebuilt as qp-crm:phase3 with the four UI fixes, container qp-crm recreated and healthy (t+7s). Verified live: _nav.html include present in-container and used by 8 admin templates, admin_authenticated checks gone from rent_templates.py/backup.py (1 doc mention each), settings page serves href="/logout", pricing base renders 'Home'. Anonymous HTTP check: /admin/rent/templates and /admin/backup_db now 302 to /login?next=<the requested page> (previously the endless /login?next=/admin/ loop), /login and /settings/ 200.
cards.rejected: 放弃了什么：editing code inside the running container (docker exec) — ephemeral, lost on the next recreate and drifts from git; and git pull in deploy.sh was skipped (SKIP_PULL=1) since the fixes are already local commits on this checkout.

cards.title: Default users removed — admin-only seeding (commit 4f3a2a1)
cards.description: SUPERSEDED by the executed change (commit 4f3a2a1 on phase-3-auth): instead of rotating the four seeded passwords, the default staff accounts were removed entirely — live DB deleted pricing/offer/rent users + their user_modules rows (backup: app_data/pricing.db.pre-default-user-removal.20260906-140914.bak), and production seeding (LEGACY_ACCOUNT_SEEDS in qp_crm/shared/auth.py) now creates ONLY the 'admin' bootstrap account, so boot/factory-restore never resurrects them. Live-verified over HTTP: pricing/offer/rent logins rejected, admin still logs in. Suite updated (conftest provisions staff accounts for tests; seed/factory-reset/restore tests pinned to admin-only contract) — 245 passed, 3 skipped. What REMAINS: rotate the admin seed password (Admin1) — tracked on its own open card with the how-to.
cards.rationale: Graded finding after Phase 3: committed default credentials still authenticated. User chose deletion over rotation ('no default users except admin; I will create all needed users').
cards.rejected: Rotating the four passwords in the UI — rejected by the user in favor of deleting the default staff accounts entirely; re-introducing forced first-login change — already retired during Phase 3 (admin-managed passwords chosen).
cards.summary: Default staff users (pricing/offer/rent) deleted from the live DB and from production seeding (admin-only bootstrap, commit 4f3a2a1); tests + docs updated; suite 245 passed.

cards.title: Rotate admin seed password (Admin1) — ~1 min user action, how-to in description
cards.description: HOW-TO (user action, ~1 min): the only account is 'admin' and its password is STILL the committed default 'Admin1' — public knowledge (repo/README) and valid forever until changed, so anyone on the LAN can log in as full admin. Do it at the next deploy moment (works any time; the password lives in the DB users row, not in code). Steps: 1) login http://<host>:5000 as admin/Admin1; 2) Admin -> Users; 3) your own row: fill New password, confirm-own-password = Admin1; 4) Save, log out, log back in with the new password. Warning: single-admin system — no email reset exists; a forgotten password means an operator resets the DB hash or restores a backup, so store it in a password manager. There is no expiry/forced change; the guards only prevent deactivating/demoting the LAST active admin and yourself.
cards.rationale: The last committed default credential (Admin1, public in README) on a single-admin system — rotating it was the final open security task after default staff accounts were removed.
cards.rejected: Code-side forced rotation was already rejected earlier (operator-managed secret); this card only needed the UI path to work, which the own-row Save fix unblocked.
cards.summary: Admin password rotated by the owner via Admin -> Users (own-row Save). This flow was BLOCKED by the dangling-form bug (users.html rendered the per-row <form> only for other users' rows, so the own-row Save had nothing to submit) — fixed in commit 1967c32 with a regression test, rebuilt and verified live, then the owner changed the password successfully.

cards.title: nginx HTTPS + domain: app side done (7e71110) — configure nginx + .env, deploy
cards.description: APP SIDE DONE (commit 7e71110, suite 251 passed): app stays on its own port 5000; qp_crm/shared/tls.py reads QP_HTTPS_ONLY=1 -> ProxyFix (x_for/x_proto) + Secure qp_session cookie + PREFERRED_URL_SCHEME=https + HSTS on https responses; QP_PUBLIC_DOMAIN stored as config; docker-compose.yml published-port bind configurable via QP_APP_BIND (0.0.0.0 default -> 127.0.0.1 when nginx fronts it) plus both env vars; .env.example + DOCKER.md nginx recipe (server block, X-Forwarded-Proto required, client_max_body_size 25m, proxy_read_timeout 120s for WeasyPrint). USER SIDE REMAINING (nginx is on their machine): 1) point domain DNS at the server, forward 80/443; 2) create the nginx server block from DOCKER.md + certbot certs; 3) set in .env: QP_HTTPS_ONLY=1, QP_PUBLIC_DOMAIN=<domain>, QP_APP_BIND=127.0.0.1; 4) ./deploy.sh and test https. Verify Secure cookie in devtools + HSTS header (curl -I).
cards.rationale: User decided: app on its own port behind NGINX (their wording) that owns HTTPS + domain. App-side enabling work implemented and tested; the remaining steps are operator actions on the nginx host, so the card now tracks those with the DOCKER.md recipe as the reference.
cards.rejected: Caddy as the proxy — rejected by the user (nginx chosen). Tailscale/WireGuard VPN — user chose reverse proxy instead. Exposing :5000 to the LAN indefinitely — fine today, but QP_APP_BIND=127.0.0.1 removes even LAN exposure once nginx is live.

cards.title: Single source of truth for date_format (audit M4, cookie vs DB)
cards.description: Audit M4: date_format has two sources of truth — the global_settings 'date_format' row (admin setting) vs the per-browser 'date_format' cookie (settings app). Phase-2/3 consolidation removed most cookie/DB duplication but date formatting still consults the cookie first in some helpers (get_date_format reads DB then falls back to cookie; several route/context paths read the cookie directly). Pick ONE authority (recommend: global_settings for admins, cookie only as a per-device override if genuinely wanted) and make every format_date call path read the same source; add a characterization test for the chosen precedence.
cards.rationale: Known inconsistency from the audit that Phase 2 deliberately deferred; it produces user-visible surprises (a user's cookie setting silently ignored or overriding the company default depending on which page they are on).
cards.rejected: Keeping both with cookie-wins semantics — rejected: PDFs must be company-consistent, not per-browser, and golden-PDF tests need deterministic formatting.
cards.summary: global_settings is the ONE source of truth for date_format (commit bb0b699, merged on Dev e54f88f). get_date_format() reads only the DB row (default YYYY-MM-DD on missing/error); the per-browser date_format cookie fallback deleted; /settings no longer reads/writes the cookie and its date-format select removed (Admin -> Default Settings is the single editor). New characterization test pins DB-wins precedence with a stale cookie present. Docs (PROGRAM_DOCUMENTATION 9.1, tests/README) updated. Suite 262 passed, 3 skipped. cards.description: New `customers` table (legal entity: PIB/MB, billing) + `customer_locations` (physical workshop sites) + `deals` (one thread per request; N concurrent per customer) + `deal_events` timeline + link to existing offers via deal_id. Replaces the old CRM + ticketing thread tracking.
cards.rationale: User confirmed Customer+Offer+Invoice first, then raised two real-world complications: customers with multiple workshops and multiple concurrent projects. cards.title: P5 — Stock & equipment: custody-only, opt-in tracking, shortfall debts, temp products, rename/merge-safe
cards.description: Phase 5 scope after six user follow-ups. (1) Single DB, single `products` catalog; per-product TRACKING REGIME, `untracked` DEFAULT (small parts = catalog entries only, no ledger/counts/movements); `qty` opt-in loose ledger; `serialized` identity tracking (rows live forever, scrap transition only). QP-CRM = custody of machines + debts between machines, NOT inventory value (audit software stays the counting truth). (2) Custody-first movements, nullable doc ref + fixed reason list. (3) Coverage loop: reservations with "for whom", first-class POs (derived status), ATP view over tracked products. (4) Fleet vans as internal custodians (NOT customer rows). (5) Donor parts as SHORTFALLS (equipment_shortfalls: device, part, taken-for, PO ref, closed_at) — two-tap mechanic flow, incomplete-device flag, orders-needed hook, auto-close on replacement receipt; timeline-note fallback allowed but loses reminders. (6) TEMP PRODUCTS app-wide: every reference is id (nullable FK) + text snapshot (name/desc/photo) — quotation already does this (offer_items.product_id NULL + item_name); warehouse movements & equipment registrations accept temp products (ad-hoc part/device without catalog row), one-click "make real product" promotes snapshot → catalog row and back-fills references. RENAME without breakage: all modules resolve names by id at read time — renaming edits one master row. MERGE 2-or-5-into-1: `product_aliases` (alias_id → canonical_id, UNIQUE alias, no chains); old ids keep resolving through the alias map; duplicate-suspect view + re-point merge tool; same machinery reusable for customers/locations later. Issued documents keep issuance-time snapshots — rename/merge never rewrites history.
cards.rationale: User's final two requirements: (a) the quotation temp-product must exist in the warehouse too (one-off parts/devices shouldn't force catalog rows), and (b) the DB being "just links" must make renames and N-into-1 merges non-breaking. Both follow from one convention (id + snapshot + alias map) that is cheap to adopt on day one and painful to retrofit — recording it before P4/P5 schemas are written.
cards.rejected: Already recorded at creation. Nothing new rejected during implementation.
cards.summary: DONE — schema batch committed. products + tracking_regime/min_stock/unit_base/pack_size (canonical CREATE + ALTER 3f, default 'untracked' — 254 existing products untouched); new tables equipment / stock_movements / reservations / equipment_shortfalls in shared/schema.py create_warehouse_tables; closed sets TRACKING_REGIMES, CUSTODIAN_TYPES (warehouse|customer|scrap), EQUIPMENT_STATUSES (6, sr), MOVEMENT_REASONS (9, sr); migrate_warehouse drops orphan rent_equipment. cards.title: BUG · factory_reset + reprovision leaves stale session user_id (pre-existing, test-order dependent)
cards.description:
Symptom: after Admin→Factory reset (users table wiped + provision_staff_accounts re-seeds), a test client logged in BEFORE the reset keeps the old session user_id, which after re-seed belongs to a different/no row → require_module sends it to /login instead of 403/200 → cross-test failures (e.g. test_role_gates assert 302==200). Reproduced on Dev, phase-3-auth, 4f3a2a1, 94ee464. Not a P4 regression; P4 suite passes when ordering differs (288 passed full suite after P4 test fixes — residual risk only in specific orderings).
Fix direction (when picked up): invalidate sessions whose user_id no longer matches the same username (store username in session alongside id and re-check in require_role/require_module), or make factory_reset reprovision deterministic ids in tests.
cards.rationale: User asked to re-check whether the bug still exists and how it would be fixed, approving only the username-bind fix; findings update the card's diagnosis (factory_reset itself benign, restore paths dangerous).
cards.summary: Re-verified on current Dev. Findings: (1) factory_reset ALONE is safe in production today — AUTOINCREMENT hands re-seeded users NEW ids, so a stale session user_id resolves to no row and require_role/require_module already do session.clear() → /login (empirically confirmed). (2) The test-order landmine is still live: session-scoped offer/rent/admin clients created before the factory_reset test get 302→/login for all later tests (reproduced: offer id=3 pre-reset → re-seeded as id=7 → 302). (3) WORSE, previously unrecorded: backup_quick_restore / restore_full swap the DB file, so an old id can reappear under a DIFFERENT username — full impersonation reproduced (session 'zorica' id=3 acted as restored row 'milan' with his grants → 200); session username was stored at login but never re-validated. FIX (user-approved, commit 97e5be4, deployed): require_role + require_module now compare session username with the resolved row's username; mismatch → session.clear() + re-login. Blocks the impersonation path and keeps factory_reset behavior clean. Full suite 356 passed / 3 skipped. REMAINING (not approved scope): the test-side landmine — factory_reset test still invalidates session-scoped clients for the rest of the session; harden the test by snapshotting/restoring the users table + sqlite_sequence around the factory_reset test if it bites again.
cards.rejected: Global auth_epoch counter in global_settings — more invasive (extra write per login, migration) for no additional coverage over the username bind. Explicit-id re-seeding in factory_reset — does not cover the restore paths and fights AUTOINCREMENT. Test-only fix (conftest hardening) — leaves the production impersonation hole open; deferred as follow-up on this card's summary.

cards.title: P5-pre — Zajednički imenik (contacts): nezavisna app za kupce/saradnice koju dele rent, ponude, poslovi, radni nalozi
cards.description:
Problem: party data is fragmented per module — offers keep client fields frozen on the document (fine), but there is no SHARED master registry: rent has its own rent_clients table, deals has customers/customer_locations, pricing has nothing, sale will need one too, radni nalozi (P5+) will need one. Every new module growing its own client table duplicates data and drifts.

Target state: ONE directory app (/contacts or /imennik) owning the party model:
- contacts: legal entities AND persons (type: company/person), name, PIB/MB/JMBG, address, city, country, email, phone, notes, archived flag (NO deletes — same convention as customers today)
- contact_locations stays as the child table (sites)
- optional tagging/categorization (kupac / saradnik / oba) so 'kupci' vs 'saradnici' is a VIEW/filter, not separate tables
- per-user grants: new module slug 'contacts' in MODULE_CHOICES (v4 rollout seeds existing staff), landing card, require_module gate — same pattern as deals
- service layer (contact_service) + UI (list with search+archive, form, detail with locations + all linked documents across modules)

Migration: rent_clients rows → contacts (one-time, idempotent, keeps ids mapped); rent_contracts keeps its FROZEN client snapshot (issuance-time convention — documents never re-resolve), but the rent UI switches its client picker to the shared directory; deals customers → contacts; offers' prefill switches to the directory.

Rule to keep: documents (offers, invoices, contracts) stay frozen snapshots — the directory is MASTER DATA only, it never retro-actively changes issued documents.

Split into tasks when picked up: T1 schema+migration, T2 service, T3 UI+grants, T4 rent switch-over, T5 offers/deals switch-over, T6 tests+reboot+handover.
cards.rationale: The user asked for the client/partner directory to be ONE independent shared app consumed by rent, offers, deals, future work-orders — not each module keeping its own client store. The deals-spine (customers table) and rent_clients already drifted into two stores; P5 (radni nalozi) will need the same data, so the unification must land before or with P5. Sequenced after P4.x which just shipped.

cards.title: Update sistem: ghcr pull-deploy + pre-deploy backup + rollback
cards.description: URAĐENO (commit 9c7c70d, branch Dev): ci.yml 'image' job pushuje ghcr.io/lakisan1/qp-crm (latest + sha-<commit>) posle pytest-a, samo na push main; docker-compose.yml image -> ghcr latest (build: ostao za lokalni dev); deploy.sh v2 = git pull → pre-deploy DB snapshot (sqlite3.backup() u kontejneru, backups/pre-deploy-<ts>.db, čuva se 10, neuspeli backup prekida deploy) → last-deployed-tag → compose pull + up -d → health-wait; rollback.sh vraća snimljeni tag (ili eksplicitan sha-) preko compose override fajla, sa svojim pre-rollback snapshotom. Verifikacija: compose config OK, backup mehanika na živoj DB OK (integrity ok, 6 usera), suite 338 passed / 3 skipped.
cards.rationale: Korisnik tražio lak remote update bez gubitka podataka, idealno pull sa gita. Podaci su već bezbedni dizajnom (bind mountovi van image-a); ovo dodaje pre-built image CI pipeline + backup/rollback okolo update operaciji.
cards.rejected: Build-on-server i auto-fallback varijanta odbijene (korisnik izabrao čist pull-mode); offsite backup (S3/rclone) van scope-a; backup preko Flask generate_full_backup_zip() odbijen jer zahteva živu app — skripte rade direktno sqlite3.backup() u kontejneru.
cards.summary: Update sistem v2 implementiran i commitovan (9c7c70d): pull-deploy sa GHCR + automatski pre-deploy backup + rollback skripta. Remote update je sada: git pull && ./deploy.sh (pull image, backup, recreate, health-wait); poništavanje: ./rollback.sh.

cards.title: GHCR image JAVAN od ranije — verified kroz registry API (moja greška u dijagnozi)
cards.description: REŠENO: korisnik je već flipovao package na Public ranije (bio sam u zabludi da je privatan — moj anoniman docker pull test je bio blokiran od sandbox docker socketa, ne od GHCR-a!). Verifikovano kroz GHCR registry API bez auth-a: manifest latest HTTP 200, tags lista javno dostupna = ['latest', 'sha-1c0b4a8...', 'sha-2bf299e...', 'sha-230c5aa...'] — tj. bilo ko može da skine image. cards.rejected: Nije bilo alternativnih puteva — ispravljena dijagnoza: docker pull blokada je bila lokalni sandbox, GHCR package je bio javan od ranije.
cards.summary: Potvrđeno: GHCR package qp-crm je JAVAN (registry API bez auth: manifest 200, tags lista vidljiva). Image za trenutnu verziju (230c5aa) je na ghcr.io. Update sistem u potpunosti operativan bez ikakvog login-a.

cards.title: Admin -> Backup tab: quick backup-i + restore tačke (UI) + full zip za migracije
cards.description: URAĐENO (commit 5134f3e, push-ovan na Dev). Admin -> Backup tab (/admin/backup): (1) Quick backup dugme — WAL-safe sqlite3.backup() snapshot žive DB u BACKUP_DIR (root/backups, chmod 600, zadrži 30 quick-*); (2) tabela SVIH .db restore tačaka u folderu: quick-*, pre-deploy-* (deploy.sh), pre-rollback-* (rollback.sh) — newest first, kind/created/size; (3) akcije: Download (tačni bajtovi), Restore (password-potvrđen, integrity check, backup()-swap, auth re-init, pre-restore safety snapshot PRVO), Delete (password-potvrđen); (4) Full System .zip download + upload-restore na tabu — za ručne kopije na druge servere/migracije; (5) DB-only par (backup_db/restore_db) UKLONJEN — 404; (6) dashboard zadržao samo Image Cleanup; (7) _nav.html: 7 linkova sada. Testovi: 9 novih (test_backup_tab.py) + smoke/nav ažurirani — suite 348 passed / 3 skipped. Backup sistem koristi ISTI sqlite3.backup() mehanizam koji je već bio integrisan (G36) — i UI i deploy skripte dele isti folder i mehanizam.
cards.rationale: Korisnik tražio odvojen Backup tab sa svim quick backup-ima/restore tačkama, full zip za ručne kopije/migracije, i bez DB-only opcije (slike su male). Update sistem (deploy.sh) već piše snapshotove u backups/ — UI ih sad i pokazuje, sve dele isti mehanizam i folder.
cards.rejected: Backup-ovi u kontejneru/image-u — odbijeno: state van bind mountova umire sa kontejnerom. Restore bez password-a — odbijeno: restore menja celu users tabelu, otmica sesije bi tiho zamenila auth bazu. Upload .zip u listu restore tačaka — odloženo: zip restore je trenutan (full sistem), skladištenje 100MB+ zipova unosi nejasnu retenciju. Zadržavanje DB-only download/upload pored quick backup-a — uklonjeno po korisnikovoj odluci (dupliranje).
cards.summary: Backup tab implementiran i push-ovan (5134f3e): quick backup-i + update-sistema restore tačke u jednoj tabeli, one-click restore sa safety snapshotom, full zip za migracije, DB-only opcija uklonjena. Suite 348 green.

cards.title: Reboot lokalne instance na novi GHCR image (v1.1.0)
cards.description: Lokalna instanca reboot-ovana na novi image: kontejner je 5h radio stari LOKALNI qp-crm:phase3 image (iz pre-update-sistema doba). Reboot urađen deploy-flow-om preko sudo (dsh nije u docker grupi): (1) pull ghcr.io/lakisan1/qp-crm:latest (digest ba046c2c...); (2) pre-deploy backup WAL-safe u backups/pre-deploy-20260923-171112.db (integrity ok, 6 usera, chmod 600 — uz sitnicu da docker cp isporuči root-owned pa chown na dsh); (3) docker compose up -d — recreate; (4) healthy na t+1s; (5) verifikacija: image=ghcr latest, rute /admin/backup + backup_quick postože, stari /admin/backup_db NE postoji, INSTALL.md u image-u je engleski, auth garda vraća 302 bez logina, port 5000 odgovara 200. Admin šifra je rotirana (default ne prolazi = ispravno stanje) — UI render taba je verifikovan kroz rute + suite (348 green u CI).
cards.summary: Reboot urađen: qp-crm sada radi ghcr.io/lakisan1/qp-crm:latest (novi image sa svim izmenama), healthy, backup ruta verifikovana, stara backup_db ruta uklonjena, pre-deploy backup snimljen pre reboot-a.
cards.rationale: Korisnik tražio reboot lokalne instance da vidi nove izmene (backup tab + engleski README + update sistem). Docker socket je root:docker, dsh van grupe — ruter preko sudo -n (passwordless radi za docker komande).
cards.rejected: docker compose build lokalno — odbijeno: cilj je pull-based flow (kao na remote instanci) i novi image je već na GHCR-u; sudo usermod -aG docker — ne treba trajna izmena za jedan reboot; docker cp + heredoc script — python u kontejneru je gutao stdin, rešeno inline exec -c.

cards.title: Uvoz musterija 2024-2026 u CRM imenik (jedan kontakt po kupcu, više adresa = lokacije)
cards.description: Uvoz musterije_kontakti_2024_2026.csv (2181 redova) u zajednički imenik. Jedan kupac = jedan kontakt; više adresa istog kupca = contact_locations. Importer: scripts_import/import_musterije.py (--dry-run / --apply). Rezultat: 2156 kontakata (1823 firme, 333 fizička lica), 21 pre postojeći linkovan + 2136 novih, 7 lokacija, 0 duplikata (PIB/IME). Idempotentno (re-run: created=0). Backup: app_data/pricing.db.pre-import.20260924-103406.bak
cards.summary: Uvezeno 2156 kontakata u app_data/pricing.db preko scripts_import/import_musterije.py. Identitet: PIB > MB > normalizovano ime; MB-collapse spaja grupe sa istim matičnim brojem i sličnim nazivom (tipfelera u PIB-u), a različite firme koje greškom dele MB (Emil Frey/GUMATRAK) ostaju odvojene. 20 pre postojećih kontakata je LINKOVANO i obogaćeno (samo prazna polja), nikad duplirano. Više adresa istog kupca = contact_locations (7 lokacija). Čišćenje izvora: street u grad-koloni (115), postal gluing (214+1), grad/stubica zamene (24), telefon iz grada (28), JIB->MB (36), JMBG (4), e-mail identitet (38), 'Kupac: X Adresa: Y' parsiranje (9), šifra klijenta -> notes (534). Testovi: 351 passed. Idempotentno, health 200.
cards.rationale: Korisnik je tražio uvoz svih kupaca iz exporta 2024-2026 u CRM bazu uz strogo pravilo: isti kupac sa više adresa se uvodi kao jedan kontakt sa lokacijama, ne kao više kontakata. Kvalitet je bila prioritet, ne brzina.
cards.rejected: Odmah INSERT bez identitete-provere (napravilo bi duplikate od 2181 reda) — odbaceno; group-by MB bez imena-provere (Emil Frey/GUMATRAK dele MB greškom izvora — pogrešna identita bi progutala pravog kupca) — odbaceno, merge samo uz sličnost naziva; preko contact_service.create_contact API-ja u petlji (sporije, bez transakcije) — koristi direktan INSERT u jednoj konekciji; brisanje naknadno pronađenih duplikata — nemoguće, imenik je no-delete (arhiva samo).

cards.title: Lokacije: glavna adresa = podrazumevana lokacija + dodatni objekti po potrebi
cards.description: Kontaktova glavna adresa (billing_address + city) je uvek podrazumevana lokacija — čita se živo iz kontakta (virtualni id 0, MAIN_LOCATION_ID), ne duplira se u contact_locations. Dodatni objekti se dodaju samo za više-objektne stranke. Offer forma: Lokacija select iznad Adresa musterije (puni se iz autofill 'sites'); izbor objekta prepisuje client_address snapshot; prazno = glavna adresa. Rent: Adresa zakupa dobija datalist predloge (glavna + objekti), polje ostaje slobodan snapshot. Imenik detail prikazuje ⭐ Glavna adresa kao prvu lokaciju. Deployed: rebuild + reboot završeni, kontejner healthy.
cards.summary: Implementirano + deployovano (commit 1981794→ HEAD, image rebuilt, reboot, healthy): contact_service.MAIN_LOCATION_ID=0 + location_choices() + resolve_location() (cross-party guard); /offer/api/contact/<id> vraća 'sites'; offer Lokacija select prepisuje client_address snapshot; rent Adresa zakupa datalist predlozi; imenik detail ⭐ Glavna adresa prva. 4 nova testa, suite 355 passed.
cards.rationale: Korisnik je postavio model-pitanje: da li lokacije treba da zamene glavnu adresu sada kad imamo 7 lokacija na 2156 kontakata. Odlučeno (user choice): glavna adresa = podrazumevana lokacija; dodatni objekti samo po potrebi — 1685 jednoadresnih musterija nosi nula dodatnih redova.
cards.rejected: Promovisanje svake glavne adrese u contact_locations red (dupliranje istog fakta, drift pri izmeni); location_id FK na dokumentima (snapshot polja već nose adresu, vraća deal-spine kompleksnost); UNIQUE is_default flag (drift moguć); globalni site picker (curenje tuđih adresa).

Imenik: tabela + forma 'Dodaj lokaciju' + kontakt forma prošireni; header Adresa = 'adresa, grad, poštanski, država'. cards.title: Imenik lista: paginacija 25/stranu (sistem iz Settings + ponuda)
cards.description: /contacts/contacts renderovao svih 2156 kontakata u jednu tabelu (sporo + beskonačan skrol). cards.title: P5-T1 · Schema: products tracking regime + equipment, stock_movements, reservations, equipment_shortfalls; drop rent_equipment
cards.description:
Schema step of P5 (blueprint §3 + amendments 2/5/6, adapted to the no-deals reality by user answers 2026-09-25). All DDL in qp_crm/shared/schema.py (single source), wired via a new warehouse.init_db() in main.py/wsgi.py/conftest boot sequence after contacts.

Tables (all with the repo conventions: id+snapshot, no deletes, names resolved at read time):
- products gains tracking columns via idempotent ALTERs in migrate_pricing: tracking_regime TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'untracked' (closed set TRACKING_REGIMES = untracked|qty|serialized), min_stock REAL NULL, unit_base TEXT NULL, pack_size REAL NULL. Existing 254 products stay untracked — zero behavior change.
- equipment (serialized instances, rows live forever): product_id NULL→products(id) (temp registrations allowed), name_snapshot TEXT NOT NULL, serial_number TEXT, custodian_type TEXT NOT NULL (CUSTODIAN_TYPES = warehouse|customer|scrap; no fleet/supplier for v1), custodian_contact_id NULL→contacts(id), since_date TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL (EQUIPMENT_STATUSES = in_stock|delivered|loaned|test_demo|in_service|scrapped), expected_return_at TEXT NULL, notes TEXT. No UNIQUE on serial_number (temp registrations and multi-site copies make it unenforceable; duplicate-serial visible in UI).
- stock_movements (the only way anything moves; never deleted, correcting = reversing movement): product_id NULL→products(id), equipment_id NULL→equipment(id), name_snapshot TEXT (temp products), qty REAL NULL (qty regime only), direction ('in'|'out'), reason TEXT NOT NULL (MOVEMENT_REASONS = purchase_in|sale|free_issue|loan|test_demo|return|service_in|scrap|stocktake_adjustment — no transfer/adjustment-without-note in v1), contact_id NULL→contacts(id) (counterparty: supplier on purchase_in, customer on sale/loan...), note TEXT, moved_at TEXT NOT NULL, moved_by NULL→users(id).

cards.title: P5-T6 · product_aliases table + service (add/resolve/merge-without-delete + duplicate suspects)
cards.description:
Rename/merge-safety half of P5 (blueprint amendment 6). This batch is the DATA + SERVICE layer ONLY — no UI, so it can run in parallel with P5-T5.

Scope (files — do NOT touch qp_crm/warehouse/**, qp_crm/services/warehouse_service.py, qp_crm/pricing/templates/**, tests/warehouse/**):
- qp_crm/shared/schema.py: add a create_product_aliases(cur) + wire it into the existing migration/init path. Table product_aliases:
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    alias TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,           -- the old/alternate name, canonicalized
    product_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES products(id),
    created_at TEXT
  Alias uniqueness is safe here (new table, no legacy rows). Follow the file's existing conventions: function docstring explaining WHY, closed-set constants at module level, idempotent CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS. Add a module-level helper if you need name canonicalization (strip + casefold).
- qp_crm/services/product_alias_service.py (new): the service layer owning
    * normalize(name) -> the canonical comparison key
    * add_alias(alias, product_id) -> (ok, msg) — validates product exists, rejects an alias that equals a live product's own name (that would be ambiguous), idempotent on repeat
    * resolve_name(name) -> product_id or None (exact product name first, then alias)
    * merge_products(source_id, target_id) -> (ok, msg): records the source product's name as an alias of the target, then repoints references. CRITICAL: this project is ARCHIVE-ONLY — do NOT delete the source product row and do NOT delete prices. Instead: insert the alias, repoint what is safe to repoint (products the source is referenced by: check stock_movements.product_id, equipment.product_id, reservations.product_id, equipment_shortfalls.part_product_id, offer_items if such a column exists — inspect the real schema and only touch columns that exist), and leave the source row in place. Return a summary of how many rows were repointed. If a reference cannot be safely repointed, say so in the message rather than silently dropping it.
    * group_duplicate_suspects() -> a read model of likely-duplicate product names (the live DB has 31 such prefix pairs, e.g. 'BODYGUARD 1.2' vs 'BODYGUARD 1.2 Spoljasnja verzija'). Pure read, no writes.
- tests: tests/pricing/test_product_aliases.py (or tests/services/) covering normalize, add_alias validation + idempotency, resolve_name both paths, merge_products repointing counts + alias created + source row NOT deleted, and duplicate-suspect grouping.

Rules: single schema source (never DDL outside shared/schema.py); no deletes anywhere; keep connections short-lived and ALWAYS close them (a leaked connection holds a WAL read lock and the next write fails with 'database is locked'); FK enforcement is ON.

Deliverables: code + tests. Run `venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/ -q` — the FULL suite must stay green (baseline 404 passed / 3 skipped). Commit on branch Dev with a descriptive message. Report: files changed, test counts, commit hash, and the exact list of reference columns you repointed.
cards.rationale: P5 blueprint amendment 6 requires that renaming a product breaks no reference and that merging duplicates is safe under the archive-only rule. The catalogue has 254 products and exactly 31 prefix-pair duplicates (verified against a read-only copy of the live DB: naive normalized startswith gives 31). Deleting the merged-away row is forbidden, so the merge needed a data structure to keep the old name resolving to the survivor plus a service that re-points real references. Done now because P5-T5 added the tracking-regime UI on the same products table; the alias map is the remaining rename/merge half of P5 and has no UI dependency, so it could run in parallel.

cards.title: INCIDENT · probe script ran against the real DB (QP_TEST_ROOT only works via conftest) — damaged products/FKs, recovered by verified rebuild
cards.description:
INCIDENT (agent-caused), fully recovered — recording so the trap is not repeated.

WHAT HAPPENED: while debugging a failing test I ran two throwaway probe scripts that set the env var QP_TEST_ROOT and then imported qp_crm.shared.bootstrap, assuming that redirected them to a scratch database. It does not. QP_TEST_ROOT is read ONLY by tests/conftest.py, which patches qp_crm.shared.config; a bare script that imports app modules gets the REAL app_data/pricing.db. Those probes therefore ran `DROP TABLE equipment/stock_movements/reservations/equipment_shortfalls` and `ALTER TABLE products RENAME TO products_pre_p5` against production.

DAMAGE: products was left EMPTY (0 rows) with the original 254 rows stranded in products_pre_p5; prices (153) and offer_items (224) had their FK clauses rewritten by SQLite's rename to `REFERENCES "products_pre_p5"(id)`, so any insert into them failed with `no such table: main.products_pre_p5`. Contacts (2156), offers (80) and every other table were untouched.

RECOVERY: rebuilt the file cleanly — read all 29 tables out of the damaged database with `PRAGMA writable_schema=ON`, built a canonical schema in a fresh file via init_all_modules(), reloaded the data, then VERIFIED row-for-row that all 28 surviving tables were byte-identical to the source, with integrity_check=ok and foreign_key_check=0 violations. Swapped it in and confirmed the app boots and serves every module. A first in-place schema-repair attempt (PRAGMA writable_schema UPDATE of sqlite_master) was abandoned: fixing the `sql` text without `tbl_name` left SQLite reporting a malformed schema, and the rebuild was cleaner and verifiable.

ARTIFACTS LEFT ON DISK: app_data/pricing.db.DAMAGED-by-probe.20260927-083941.bak (pre-repair state) and app_data/pricing.db.repair-inprogress.083953.bak (mid-repair). Both are disposable once the user is satisfied; the live pricing.db is verified good.
cards.summary: Production app_data/pricing.db damaged by my own probe scripts (they assumed QP_TEST_ROOT isolated them; only tests/conftest.py honours it) and FULLY RECOVERED. All 254 products, 2156 contacts, 80 offers, 153 prices, 224 offer_items restored; verified row-for-row identical for all 28 tables, integrity_check=ok, 0 FK violations; app boots and serves /, /pricing/, /contacts/, /offer/, /warehouse/, /sale/, /settings/ with no errors. Two disposable .bak copies of the damaged/intermediate state remain in app_data/ for the user to delete.
cards.rationale: The user was away and asked me to work autonomously; a production-data incident is exactly the thing they must be told about even though it was fully recovered. It also documents a real footgun (QP_TEST_ROOT looks like it isolates any script but only conftest honours it) and the exact recovery procedure, so the next session does not re-derive it — or repeat the mistake.
cards.rejected: Restoring a pre-existing backup (app_data/*.bak from Sep 24/26) — rejected because the newest predates the 2156-contact imenik import, so it would have lost real user work; in-place data recovery preserved everything. Finishing the writable_schema surgery — rejected once it produced a malformed-schema error; a clean rebuild was verifiable row-for-row and took one pass. 5. Rename-safety proof — the blueprint's acceptance criterion 'rename & merge demos break nothing' is covered by unit tests for resolve_name/merge_products but there is no end-to-end demo on a real document (offer/rent PDF) after a rename.
cards.rationale: These were consciously cut from P5 to keep each batch reviewable and because the user answered that no fleet exists, POs are free-text for now, and the alias UI could come after the data layer. Recording them now prevents the 'done' P5 cards from implying the blueprint is fully realised — the module is usable today, but merge tooling has no screen and the API cannot set a regime.
cards.rejected: Folding these into P5 as originally scoped — rejected mid-flight because fleet/POs would have invented screens for data the user has not asked to enter, and because building the merge UI in the same batch as the alias service would have collided on pricing templates/routes with the tracking-regime work. Building the merge UI blind (auto-merging the 31 detected suspects) was rejected outright: irreversible automation on real catalogue data.

cards.title: Izrada tabele uređaja (bez cena) iz svih cenovnika 2023–2026 za postepeni unos u CRM
cards.description:
STATUS: odluke zaključane — spremno za izradu. Kompletna specifikacija zadatka: `tmp-excel/START-HERE.md` (taj fajl se daje novoj instanci).

>>> ZA SLEDEĆU SESIJU / LOKALNI MODEL: pročitaj `tmp-excel/START-HERE.md` i radi po njemu. <<<

ZAKLJUČANE ODLUKE KORISNIKA:
1. Opisi — HIBRID: gde izvor ima pravi opis (`mh-products-baseline-by-category.xlsx`, 528 proizvoda sa opisima) preuzmi ga; inače generiši minimalan opis iz naziva. Ništa se ne izmišlja. Kolona `Opis izvor` beleži `izvor` vs `generisan`.
2. Duplikati — normalizuj i spoji, konzervativnim ključem (lowercase + sklonjena interpunkcija + spojeni razmaci). `Geodyna 7340` i `Geodyna 7340 S` se NE spajaju (različiti proizvodi); `Geoliner 609` = `GEOLINER 609` se spajaju. Fuzzy spajanje van obima.
3. Obim — samo stavke koje se pojavljuju ≥ 2 puta kroz sve fajlove. Jednokratne idu u list `Singlovi (iskljuceni)`, ne u glavnu tabelu (ništa se ne briše).
4. Format — SAMO `.xlsx`, bez `.csv`, BEZ uvoza u `pricing.db`.

IZLAZ: `tmp-excel/tabela-uredjaja.xlsx`, četiri lista — `Uredjaji` (glavna), `Singlovi (iskljuceni)`, `Odbaceno` (sa razlogom), `Sumarno`. Skripta: `tmp-excel/build_table.py`.

KRITIČNO: NE pozivati `ask_user_question` — sesija je pukla jer je lokalni model ~390 puta ponavljao pokvaren poziv tog alata. Ako nešto blokira, napisati običnim tekstom i stati.
cards.rationale: Korisnik je tražio konsolidovan katalog uređaja iz 112 Excel cenovnika/kalkulacija za postepeni ručni unos proizvoda u CRM. Odluke su bile zaključane unapred (hibridni opisi, konzervativno spajanje, ≥2 pojavljivanja u glavnoj tabeli, bez cena, samo .xlsx) — urađeno tačno po specifikaciji iz tmp-excel/START-HERE.md.
cards.rejected: Fuzzy spajanje varijanti (npr. „Mašina za balansiranje točkova HOFMANN GEODYNA 7340S" vs „Geodyna 7340 S") — van obima po §5, bolje propustiti duplikat nego pogrešno spojiti dva proizvoda. Fuzzy poklapanje sa mh-baseline opisima (samo exact-normalized ključ, 144/1262 pogodaka) — agresivnije poklapanje bi unosilo pogrešne opise. Uvoz u pricing.db i dodirivanje baze — zabranjeno odlukom §2.4. PDF/ZIP/MSG izvori — preskočeni (cene nam ne trebaju; MSG sadrži samo 8 akcijskih redova koji već postoje u Excel fajlovima).
cards.summary: Napravljen tmp-excel/build_table.py koji obrađuje 110 Excel fajlova (71 xlsx + 41 xls preko xlrd) iz priloga i proizvodi tmp-excel/tabela-uredjaja.xlsx sa 4 lista: Uredjaji (2012 stavki ≥2 pojavljivanja), Singlovi (794), Odbaceno (138: sekcijski naslovi 70, broj-bez-naziva 25, prekratko 23, samo-brojevi 20), Sumarno. Opisi hibridni: 146 iz izvora (mh-baseline), ostali generisani minimalno iz naziva; QC potvrđuje 0 URL-ova i 0 cena u opisima, max 1999 znakova.
